s1.desc: a room with rounded archways drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: 20 frames, camera locked (door patch tracked 1.00, 0 px): Polly waddles out of a far archway toward the right past an open door at the left edge

spans.view: with a pale aqua desk holding a laptop and a parcel in the foreground and a shell-shaped chair at the edge

beats.text: Polly edges out from behind the side of the archway, only one flipper showing at first
Polly stands at the edge of the archway with both flippers stretched out to the side, eyes wide
Polly creeps sideways to the left with small shuffling steps
Polly stops in the archway and stands glancing to the side with a cautious look
